name: Ancient Gurubashi Secrets
summary: Lan'dalock asks you to recover an idol from an ancient Gurubashi ruin newly risen off Stranglethorn Vale. The site may hold valuable clues to Gurubashi blood magic.

sections.title: A Ruin Risen
sections.body: Lan'dalock and you have been discussing a strange change in the South Seas. An ancient Gurubashi ruin has appeared off Stranglethorn Vale's coast. Its sudden return draws the interest of those who study the past.

sections.title: An Idol of the Gurubashi
sections.body: The Drowned City holds artifacts of great archaeological worth. Lan'dalock seeks an idol once used by certain Gurubashi witch doctors as a focus for blood magic. You are asked to bring one back for study.

faq.answer: Lan'dalock and a companion seek an Ancient Gurubashi Idol from the Drowned City.

faq.q: Where did the Gurubashi ruin appear?
faq.answer: The ancient Gurubashi ruin appeared off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale in the South Seas.

faq.q: Why do they want an idol?
faq.answer: Certain ancient Gurubashi witch doctors used idols as focuses for blood magic, and Lan'dalock wants one for study.
It is an ancient Gurubashi ruin that has appeared off Stranglethorn Vale's coast.
